segments.en: Hello.
Hi.
Hi, where are you calling from?
From Bangalore. You?
I am from Bangalore too.
My MBA is complete, so I am at home.

Sorry, I didn't understand. I can't hear you, what?
Why are you talking like this? I don't get it.
Which way are you talking?
Can we talk?
We can talk, but what do I get out of it if I talk?
What?
We can talk, but what do I get out of it if I talk?
What do you mean?
What?
For whom? For you or for me?
For me.
What should I do? I will pay you.
Will you finish it in the meantime?
Hmm, okay.
If you pay, then I will do a video call or voice call.
Okay, sorry, sorry. Talk like that.
Okay.
Okay.
Can we talk about something else?
Sorry, I really can't talk about anything else.
Okay, sorry.
